Build prompt

Rebuild this animation 1:1: WhatsApp's username intro - a looping vector illustration of a green @ speech bubble, waving hand, paper plane, and coin tokens gently bobbing and tumbling above the "Usernames are coming soon" explainer.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Settings-style screen titled "Username": illustration cluster top-third, headline "Usernames are coming soon. Reserve yours today.", two bullet rows with icons, and a "Learn more" link. Everything is WhatsApp green on off-white.

## Motion spec
Pattern: looping illustration idle - independent bob and tumble on each graphic element.
- The @ bubble floats vertically (+/- 8px, 2.8s, ease-in-out) with a slight tilt (+/- 3deg).
- The waving hand rocks from its wrist pivot (rotate -8 -> 8deg, 2.2s, ease-in-out).
- The paper plane loops a small figure-eight drift (24px wide, 3.5s) with a matching bank angle.
- Coin tokens tumble in place (rotateY 360deg, 4s, linear) at staggered phases.
- All loops run continuously with offset phases so the cluster never synchronizes.

## Calibration
- Every element moves gently - this is ambient motion, not a celebration.
- Text and layout below the illustration never move.

## Reduced motion
All loops stop; the illustration renders as a single static frame.

## Don't miss
- Offset phases: no two elements hit their extremes at the same time.
- The paper plane's bank follows its path direction.
